title: Words Meet Photos: When and Why Photos Increase Review Helpfulness
design_notes: Not a DiD or event-study paper. Review-level OLS on Yelp reviews (Has Photos, text-photo similarity) with restaurant and year-month fixed effects, clustered by restaurant, plus five laboratory experiments. No treatment adoption dates.
eligible_reason: No treatment that switches on at unit-specific dates; cross-sectional review-level regressions and lab experiments. The Bertrand-Duflo-Mullainathan citation is only for clustering.
estimators_reported: OLS with restaurant and year-month FE
screener_notes: Yelp review/photo data collected by the authors (7.4M reviews, 2004-2020); no package in batch and no data availability statement in the article text. Flagged only via citation of Bertrand, Duflo and Mullainathan (2004).
screened_from: article text only (no package_dir or regressions file in batch_t2_004)
